description: Move columns by visible-only index (index 0 = leftmost shown column, hidden columns not counted). Use when you want to position relative to what the user sees. Use `move_overall_columns` when you need to position relative to the full underlying column order including hidden fields. ⚠️ The API preserves existing relative order of supplied IDs — to place columns in a custom sequence, issue one call per column with incrementing targets.

columnIds.description: Field IDs to move as a contiguous block to targetVisibleIndex. ⚠️ The Airtable API preserves existing relative order of the supplied IDs — it does NOT re-sequence them by input array order. To place columns in a specific custom sequence, issue separate single-column calls with incrementing targets (e.g. ["fldA"]→1, ["fldB"]→2, ["fldC"]→3).

debug.description: When true, include raw Airtable response in output for diagnostics

targetVisibleIndex.description: Destination index in the visible-only column ordering (0 = leftmost visible)

name: move_visible_columns
